verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents three ways to test without touching production. Unit tests run in-memory and mock all external calls. Integration tests deploy ephemeral infrastructure and test against it. `pulumi preview` shows planned changes without modifying the stack. Together these cover the core of sandboxed testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolated per-environment stacks separating sandbox from production data, agent-specific sandbox guardrails tying the MCP server or Neo to non-production environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
